name: Brotherhood Initiate
traitSummary: One extra Tag skill (Energy Weapons, Science or Repair); you must follow your superiors' orders or be cast out of the Brotherhood.

name: Ghoul
traitSummary: Immune to radiation damage and healed by it; Survival becomes a Tag skill; some people distrust ghouls.

name: Super Mutant
traitSummary: +2 STR and END with a higher maximum, lower maximum INT and CHA, at most 4 ranks per skill; immune to radiation and poison damage.

name: Mister Handy
traitSummary: Hovering robot with all-round senses and three arm attachments; immune to radiation and poison, no chems, repairs instead of healing, fixed carry weight of 150 lbs.

name: Survivor
traitSummary: Pick two Survivor traits, or one trait and one extra perk.

name: Vault Dweller
traitSummary: Easier END tests against disease and one extra Tag skill; the GM may bring in complications from your Vault's experiment, which refund a Luck point.

name: Generation 3 Synth
traitSummary: One extra Tag skill; no need for food, drink or sleep; immune to radiation, poison and disease; distrusted by those who know, and bound by an Institute recall code.

name: Protectron
traitSummary: Robot built for a purpose: a reroll against environmental hazards once per scene, immune to radiation, poison and disease, repairs instead of healing, up to two robot mods, fixed carry weight of 225 lbs.

name: Child of Atom
traitSummary: One extra perk at level 1 and a base radiation DR of 1; absorbs radiation for nearby allies and stores up to 5 Radiation Points to boost melee damage.

name: Assaultron
traitSummary: Combat robot with clawed hands, a head laser and a self-destruct option; immune to radiation, poison and disease, repairs instead of healing, fixed carry weight of 150 lbs.

name: Brotherhood Outcast
traitSummary: One extra Tag skill (Energy Weapons, Science or Repair) and extra junk and loot at the start; you left the Brotherhood to follow your own goals.

name: Nightkin
traitSummary: Super mutant body (+2 STR and END, limited INT and CHA, at most 4 ranks per skill, immune to radiation and poison) with a risk of Stealth Boy addiction.

name: Tribal
traitSummary: Pick two Tribal or two Survivor traits, or one trait and one extra perk.
